semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Daitec provides specialized piping and installation services for semiconductor facilities, which are critical for maintaining cleanroom environments and process integrity.
summary: Daitec offers specialized welding and installation services for semiconductor facilities, focusing on high-pressure, vacuum, and gas piping systems. Their expertise in titanium and Hastelloy welding supports the stringent requirements of semiconductor manufacturing environments.
capabilities: Welding of titanium and Hastelloy for semiconductor applications
Installation of sanitary and high-pressure piping systems
On-site assembly and installation services for semiconductor plants
Manufacturing of hydrogen-related and titanium parts
